title: Canonical map from a complex of modules to the derived pushforward, functorial in the triple
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter cohomology.tex (Cohomology of Sheaves)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a morphism of ringed spaces f: X to Y, a bounded below complex G of O_Y-modules and a morphism of complexes phi: G to f_*F, the lemma produces a canonical morphism G to Rf_*(F) in D^+(Y) and asserts functoriality in the triple (G, F, phi) (statement lines 2330-2345). The construction is explicit: choose an injective resolution F to I, recall that Rf_*(F) is represented by f_*I in K^+(Y), compose phi with f_* of the resolution to get a morphism in K^+(Y), and apply the localization functor to D^+(Y) (proof lines 2348-2357). The claim is H2: the content is the correct choice of representative for the derived pushforward plus the compatibility of the localization functor, which the author states in one sentence rather than spelling out.
